context.passage:
To: | | warren.cluett @reva.org |
From: | [ delia.kwon@reva.org |
Date: | [June 30 |
Subject: | [ Shipment arrival |
Hi Warren,
We will be receiving a shipment of bricks tomorrow morning. — [1] —. When the truck
arrives, please take inventory as the shipment is unloaded and verify that the quantities on
the receipt are accurate. — [2] —. In addition, please make sure that the bricks are
stacked no more than three bricks high. — [3] —. They are fragile, and I am concerned
that they might crack from the pressure if they are stacked in tall piles.
— [4] —. Please also confirm the successful arrival of materials and report any problems
to me by e-mail.
Thank you,
Delia Kwon
LSAL @
Manager, Reva Development
a
157. In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3],

choices: To provide instructions to an employee
To address a mistake with a shipment
To place an order for bricks
To record the inventory for a shipment
items.question: What is the purpose of the e-mail? 157.
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：篇章中可定位到“that they might crack from the pressure if they are stacked in tall piles.”。选择理由：该项复现或同义改写了定位信息，其他选项与原文细节不一致。正确答案：A（To provide instructions to an employee）。
